description: maisecrets: block prompts that carry secrets or PII, rehydrate placeholders in Bash, redact tool results.

hooks.command:
set -- `# <#`
if [ -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" ]; then bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.sh" session-start; else printf '%s' '{"systemMessage":"maisecrets: its folder is gone (a plugin update moved it while this session was open). Run /reload-plugins in Claude Code; in Codex, exit and run codex resume. Until then maisecrets blocks this."}'; fi; exit
: <<'#PS_END'
#>
$r = "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.cmd"; $m = 'maisecrets: its folder is gone (a plugin update moved it while this session was open). Run /reload-plugins. Until then maisecrets blocks this.'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $r) { $m = 'maisecrets: PowerShell could not start hooks/run.cmd. Until then maisecrets blocks this.'; $global:LASTEXITCODE = 424242; try { & $r session-start } catch {}; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 424242) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }; '{"systemMessage": "' + $m + '"}'; exit 0
#PS_END
hooks.commandWindows: if exist "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.cmd" ("${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/run.cmd" session-start) else (echo {"systemMessage": "maisecrets: its folder is gone, a plugin update removed it while this session was open. Exit and resume the session with codex resume. Until then maisecrets blocks this."})
